title: RRB Junior Engineer JE CBT II Answer Key 2026
vacancyDetails: Provisional CBT-2 answer key, question paper and response sheet for RRB JE
qualification: Diploma / Degree in Engineering in relevant branch as per JE CEN
ageLimit: As per RRB JE CEN rules
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rrb.digialm.com
2. Login with Registration Number and DOB
3. Open JE CBT-2 Answer Key / Response Sheet
4. Download PDFs and calculate score
5. Raise objections within window (key out 10 July; objections till ~17 July 2026)
shortDescription: RRB JE CBT-2 Answer Key 2026 released on 10 July for exam on 2 July 2026 (CEN 05/2025). Download from rrb.digialm.com.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards have released the RRB JE CBT-2 Answer Key 2026 on 10 July 2026 for CEN 05/2025.

CBT-2 exam: 2 July 2026. Candidates can view question paper, recorded responses and provisional key via rrb.digialm.com login and challenge answers within the notified period.
